description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a single GET endpoint '/items/'. It demonstrates the use of FastAPI's Query parameter validation with Annotated and Union types, including setting a minimum length for a query parameter.

methods.name: read_items( q: Annotated[Union[str, None], Query(title="Query string", min_length=3)] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint handler that retrieves items and optionally filters them based on the query parameter 'q', which includes validation constraints.
